Monkeytype guest widget

Based on Monkeytype, revision 91bd24bb8513785c7364cbea29296ff7adafac41, version 26.32.0. Modified by Keyconf on September 5, 2026.

This independent guest integration retains Monkeytype's typing and result engine. It adds the keyboard connection and a compact theme. Accounts, backend services, analytics, ads, and service workers are disabled.
